editing: Recorded browser interactions in chronological case order; idle gaps between steps and one static download pause removed. Extraction footage plays at captured speed.
gemini: Configuration controls only; no new cloud requests.

clips.name: local-workflow
clips.caption: DamnLens AI Agent converts PDFs and scans into structured Excel. Start with the keyless Local AI workflow.

clips.name: invoice-extraction
clips.caption: Upload a digital PDF. The agent detects tables and headers, joins three pages and preserves all 31 rows across 12 columns.

clips.name: invoice-source
clips.caption: Click an extracted row to open its original source page and highlight the matching location.

clips.name: invoice-coverage
clips.caption: Inspect page-by-page coverage and extraction routes. Every invoice row retains source evidence.

clips.name: scanned-pdf
clips.caption: The image-only inventory PDF is read with local English OCR. Watch page progress, table reconstruction and validation complete.

clips.name: scan-source
clips.caption: Inspect an OCR row against the scanned source. The two pages produce 20 rows and 12 columns.

clips.name: image-result
clips.caption: Open the standalone PNG result: 10 rows and 12 reconstructed columns, with the original image available beside the data.

clips.name: fifty-pages
clips.caption: The 50-page document produces 500 rows and 12 columns. Repeated headers are removed; duplicate business rows are preserved and flagged.

clips.name: fifty-coverage
clips.caption: All 50 pages remain individually accessible, with source evidence retained for all 500 rows.

clips.name: nested-headers
clips.caption: Expand the detected header structure to inspect parent and child labels in a nested line-item table.

clips.name: merged-origin
clips.caption: Select a shared order ID to inspect the original merged cell. Inherited values retain their source geometry.

clips.name: split-row-first
clips.caption: A description continues across pages. The reconstructed row keeps links to both original source fragments.

clips.name: split-row-second
clips.caption: Switch to the second source part to inspect the continued description on page two.

clips.name: bank-extraction
clips.caption: The bank statement includes intentional source errors. The agent preserves the values and flags them for review.

clips.name: bank-validation
clips.caption: Validation identifies missing fields, running-balance errors and a total that does not reconcile.

clips.name: inspect-total
clips.caption: Open the total finding to inspect its original row. The stated debit total is 2,600; contributing rows sum to 2,500.

clips.name: inspect-missing-cell
clips.caption: Locate the missing currency field in its source page before making an explicit correction.

clips.name: open-correction
clips.caption: Open the cell editor. The original extracted value will remain in the correction history.

clips.name: save-correction
clips.caption: For this demonstration, enter USD from the statement context. Validation reruns and the finding count updates from six to five.

clips.name: correction-history
clips.caption: The correction history retains the original blank, the entered value, its location and the time of the edit.

clips.name: review-dialog
clips.caption: Review confirms source checks and requires acknowledgement of outstanding findings.

clips.name: complete-review
clips.caption: Record a review note. The remaining source errors stay visible and are acknowledged for this export.

clips.name: excel-export
clips.caption: The Excel export includes structured data, review status, findings, source evidence, corrections, page coverage and the run log.

clips.name: download-excel
clips.caption: Download the reviewed Excel workbook. Outstanding findings remain included in the file.

clips.name: gemini-workflow
clips.caption: Optional Gemini assistance adds an independent reading of difficult pages. It requires a configured API key and explicit authorization.

clips.name: gemini-request-limit
clips.caption: Set a request limit and page scope. Google API plan and quotas apply; Local AI remains available without a key.

clips.name: accuracy-report
clips.caption: The three bundled sample PDFs have matching Excel outputs and ground truth: 864 matching data cells, with headers checked separately.
